name: hud_ui_panel_invalidate
description: HudUiPanel::Invalidate marks panel text dirty and invalidates the base element.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40be90 stores 1 to self+0x270, then tail-jumps to HudUiElement::Invalidate at 0x4b4180.
Native smoke zhud_panel_text_color_shadow_smoke sets g_HudUi_InvalidateMask to 0x80, calls HudUiPanel::Invalidate, and verifies both element flags and the panel text-dirty field are set.
